recommendation: Keep this core template fix. If the open Kindling or IG-template GitHub issues still matter for non-core publishing surfaces, handle them in those external tooling repositories or through a focused tooling review rather than broadening this core source reconciliation.
issue_request: FHIR-19967 was Published with resolution Persuasive with Modification. It requested replacing the confusing profile publishing label "Snapshot" with "Full Structure" and adding explanatory text for the differential and consolidated profile views in the core profile/extension publication process.
initial_application: Jira-tagged commit aae540952c changed the profile template's main tab from "Snapshot Table" to "Full Structure" and added the requested differential and consolidated-view descriptions. The current extension template already uses "Full Structure", but the profile template's combined "All" tab still retained the old "Snapshot View" heading for the same consolidated structure section.
additional_context: FHIR-I Confluence minutes show the group considered alternate labels such as "Full Snapshot" and "Full View (Snapshot)" before deciding at WGM to use "Full Structure" while keeping explanatory text that mentions the technical snapshot name. The Jira comment also created external follow-up issues for Kindling and the IG template; the current core checkout still has a hidden ad-hoc IG StructureDefinition template with a "Snapshot" heading, but that is a separate tooling surface rather than the active core profile/extension template fixed here.
reconciliation: Changed tools/templates/template-profile.html so the combined "All" tab labels the consolidated profile section "Full Structure", matching the main tab and the approved terminology while preserving the explanatory "aka snapshot" text.
source_changes: tools/templates/template-profile.html: renamed the All-tab consolidated profile section heading from "Snapshot View" to "Full Structure".
